name: Rory Gatlin
source:
"It's not like I want to hold your hand while watching the sun set on a warm summer's evening or something." 

A secret romantic who’s a little rough around the edges, Rory is trying to separate from an old life into a brighter future. He has a creative streak and passion for his interests, including painting, cooking, and tending to his vegetable garden. In tune to other’s emotions, he’ll always have your best interests at heart, even if he won’t admit to it.

Facts:
• Has a sailor’s mouth
• Can correctly recycle
• Overly enthusiastic about eggplant varieties

[From the [url=https://www.velvetfoxgames.com/infiniteblue.html]official website[/url]]
